trans-unit.source: It has been a long road, hasn't it?
trans-unit.target: It has been a long road, hasn't it?

trans-unit.source: Don't get all sentimental on me, now.
trans-unit.target: Don't get all sentimental on me, now.

trans-unit.source: If we all work together on this, we'll beat him down no problem!
trans-unit.target: If we all work together on this, we'll beat him down no problem!

trans-unit.source: We just gotta be sure we have what it takes.
trans-unit.target: We just gotta be sure we have what it takes.

trans-unit.source: Let us go! To Dhaos' castle!
trans-unit.target: Let us go! To Dhaos' castle!
